reason: The text describes Moses (who is not a priest—Aaron holds that role) building an altar (וַיִּבֶן מֹשֶׁה מִזְבֵּחַ) and dedicating it to Yahweh. This demonstrates that non-priests engaged in religious acts involving altars dedicated to God. While the text shows altar-building rather than explicitly describing a sacrifice offering, building an altar for worship is incompatible with a rule that restricts all sacrificial religious acts exclusively to priests.
